answer: A reactor-safety-style agent economy can resist sybils by treating each identity as an island whose reputation must anchor to a physically attested hardware root before it can join the shared reef of trusted peers. Colluding identities that vouch for one another without independent attestation are quarantined by a consensus check that compares cross-attestation graphs against. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
